empty.en: No matching references. Try a brand, full part number or a listed alias.
empty.zh: 未找到匹配项，请尝试品牌、完整料号或已列出的别名。

intro.en: Manufacturer-identified finished assemblies for this application.
intro.zh: 此应用范围内经原厂资料核验的成品组件。

intro.en: Category-specific material references; the final BOM follows the approved configuration.
intro.zh: 此类选型的材料参考；最终 BOM 以确认配置为准。

copy.en: A lighting harness is not defined by a bulb socket alone. Lamp technology, optical function, circuit current, switching method, body controller, diagnostics, connector keying, route, thermal zone, sealing and destination-market requirements determine the released assembly. A connector that fits can still have the wrong pinout, ground strategy, load capacity or control architecture.
copy.zh: 汽车灯线束不能只凭灯泡插座定义。灯具技术、光学功能、回路电流、开关方式、车身控制器、诊断、连接器防错、走线、热区、密封与目标市场要求共同决定放行组件。连接器即使能插合，也可能存在针脚、接地策略、负载能力或控制架构错误。

copy.en: Provide vehicle or equipment identity; model year and market; lamp positions and technologies; lamp, bulb, driver and mating-connector data; system voltage; circuit and pin tables; continuous, inrush and fault current; fuse, relay, BCM, PWM or LIN control; ground strategy; route and branch datums; temperature, water, salt, vibration and flex exposure; drawings or samples; labels; quantity; and required validation.
copy.zh: 请提供车辆或设备身份、年款与市场、灯位与灯具技术、灯具、灯泡、驱动器和对插件资料、系统电压、回路与针脚表、持续、冲击与故障电流、保险、继电器、BCM、PWM 或 LIN 控制、接地策略、走线与分支基准、温度、水、盐、振动及弯折暴露、图纸或样品、标签、数量与所需验证。

copy.en: Approved requirements become controlled drawings, pin and circuit tables, BOMs, cut lists, splice maps, branch datums, protection instructions, labels and test definitions. First articles are checked for mating, reach, lamp installation, current path, voltage drop and agreed functions before repeat production. Harness, lamp, vehicle configuration, fixture and inspection records remain linked by revision.
copy.zh: 批准需求会转化为受控图纸、针脚与回路表、物料表、裁线表、接续图、分支基准、防护工艺、标签与测试定义。重复生产前检查首件的对插、可达、灯具装配、电流路径、压降与约定功能，线束、灯具、车辆配置、工装及检验记录按版本保持关联。

copy.en: Confirm the exact mating interface, pin map, dimensions and installation orientation.
copy.zh: 确认准确对插接口、针脚对应、尺寸及安装方向。

copy.en: Agree the sample configuration and electrical, mechanical or environmental checks required by the project.
copy.zh: 约定样品配置以及项目所需的电气、机械或环境检查。

copy.en: Record changes to materials, drawings and process instructions before repeat manufacture.
copy.zh: 重复制造前记录材料、图纸与工艺说明的变更。

boundary.en: Send the part number, drawing or sample to confirm the replacement configuration and sourcing plan.
boundary.zh: 请提供型号、图纸或样品，具体替代配置与原厂件采购方案按项目确认。

text.en: Send the model or part number to discuss your project.
text.zh: 提交型号或料号，沟通您的定制与采购需求。
